data.body: Final stocktake after Gerrit 1817 merged: puppylike-emo-rasbora and parent inedible-subsimious-brahmancow are closed, the latter after signed completion-verifier PASS. All 501 normalized test phases at or above 1s were audited; no sampled CI pytest phase exceeded 30s. The three newest qualifying full runs were 22m47s, 26m14s, and 25m53s: mean 24m58s, median 25m53s, within the 20-30 minute average target. The 57m29s failure was 25m13s superseded-run admission plus a 30m23s macOS job, not a long individual test; Gerrit 1792 addressed that failure mode. Mutation jobs used 53m42s aggregate runner time when selected but finished before macOS and added zero sampled critical-path wall. Gerrit 1817 is estimated to save about 8s macOS wall and 24.84 aggregate runner-seconds by moving only proven platform-invariant tests. RAM-disk treatments remain rejected because they were 5.5-20% slower. Blocked fidelity-sensitive residuals: panpsychic-clever-hawk and ravenous-beribboned-walleye. Open unclaimed follow-ups: songful-groovelike-horsemouse, lead-unpleasing-kitten, reasonable-kingsize-polliwog, and rival-ammoniacal-crustacean. This finalization made no code edits, pushes, workflow dispatches, or control patchsets.
